title: Kessler Psychological Distress Scale (K6)
sourceName: Ronald C. Kessler — official K6/K10 source and use terms
citation: Kessler, R. C., et al. (2003). Screening for serious mental illness in the general population. Archives of General Psychiatry, 60(2), 184–189.
prompt: During the past 30 days, about how often did you feel:
useNotice: Official source documents free use / no copyright claim. This digital version is not independently validated and is not diagnostic. Interpret only within an appropriate clinical, research, or population context.
questions: so depressed that nothing could cheer you up?
scoringNote: Sum six responses (0–24). This implementation reports raw score only; no severity category or diagnosis.
